annotations.title: Start the AI Working Style Quiz

description: Start the Best Of Motivation AI Working Style Quiz (10 questions, about 2 minutes). Use when the user wants to find out how they should use AI at work, their AI working style, or asks for an AI quiz. Returns the questions and a quiz_key. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which result an option points to and do not guess the result yourself: when all 10 are answered, call score_ai_working_style_quiz with the letters and the quiz_key.
name: start_ai_working_style_quiz
